title: Social Media Influencer | Studio 1947
description: Join Studio 1947 as a Social Media Influencer in Mirik, Darjeeling. A storyteller who builds communities and shares the people and projects behind us.
ogDescription: Be the face behind the stories. A content-creation role for storytellers who want to build meaningful influence.

Apply for this role

Be the Face Behind the Stories

We're looking for a creative storyteller who knows how to connect with people online.

This isn't just a social media role. It's a chance to make content that starts conversations, builds communities, and shows off the people, projects, ideas and experiences that make Studio 1947 what it is.

If you're always thinking up content ideas, spotting trends, making reels, trying new formats and working out what grabs attention, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  1. 01

    Make engaging short-form and long-form content.

  2. 02

    Create reels, videos, stories and behind-the-scenes content.

  3. 03

    Represent Studio 1947 across social media platforms.

  4. 04

    Take part in campaigns, events, interviews and creative shoots.

  5. 05

    Work with designers, marketers and communication teams.

  6. 06

    Build real engagement with online communities.

  7. 07

    Keep up with trends, formats and new platform features.

  8. 08

    Bring ideas that help grow our online presence.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong on-camera presence and communication skills.
  • Creativity and storytelling ability.
  • Understanding of social media culture and trends.
  • Confidence in creating engaging content.
  • Ability to connect with audiences in a genuine way.
  • Consistency, curiosity, and enthusiasm.

Nice to Have

  • Existing social media presence.
  • Photography or videography skills.
  • Basic editing experience.
  • Experience working with brands or campaigns.

Why Join Studio 1947?

You'll have interesting projects, inspiring people, creative spaces and unusual stories to draw on. From technology and design to culture, community and innovation, you'll never run short of things to make content about.

This is a role for creators who want to build influence that means something, not just chase trends.

Collaborate With Us

Tell us about you and your audience. We read every submission and reply within a week to the creators we would like to work with.

About you

Prefer email? Send your media kit to studio@1947.io.

Ready to Apply?

Send us your social media profiles, content samples, portfolio, or anything that shows your creativity and personality.

Apply Now
